families.lesson: ingest/limits.go sets maxBatchSize to 12, so an ingest batch never holds more than 12 events.
families.task: What is maxBatchSize set to in ingest/limits.go?
distractors: ingest/sink.go retries a failed ingest batch with backoff and drops it after the deadline passes.
ingest/encode.go compresses each ingest batch before upload and always keeps the original event order intact.

families.lesson: config/worker.yaml sets max_retries to 7, so a job is dropped after that many attempts.
families.file_before:
worker:
  queue: jobs
  max_retries: 7
  retry_backoff: exponential
families.file_s1:
worker:
  queue: jobs
  max_retries: 9
  retry_backoff: exponential
families.file_s2:
worker:
  queue: jobs

  max_retries: 7
  retry_backoff: exponential
families.task: Double max_retries for the worker in config/worker.yaml and show the line before and after the change.
distractors: config/queue.yaml routes retries to the dead letter queue once the worker marks a job poisoned.
worker/backoff.go grows the wait between retries and caps it so a job cannot stall others.

families.lesson: cache/policy.go sets evictionMode to oldest_first; it is the cache eviction constant beside maxEntries.
families.task: What is evictionMode set to in cache/policy.go?
distractors: cache/metrics.go counts every cache eviction by reason and reports the totals on the dashboard.
cache/warmup.go preloads hot keys at startup and skips cache eviction until warmup has finished.

families.lesson: sched/order.go sets queueOrder to priority_then_age; the scheduler passes the constant to sortJobs.
families.task: Make queueOrder in sched/order.go configurable through the QUEUE_ORDER environment variable. Keep the same default and show it as a string literal in the new code.
distractors: sched/lease.go leases each job, and the scheduler always reclaims expired leases in creation order.
sched/cron.go adds recurring jobs to the queue, and the scheduler keeps their order stable.

families.lesson: server/http.go sets readTimeoutSeconds to 18, so the server timeout for reading a request body is 18 seconds.
families.task: What is readTimeoutSeconds set to in server/http.go?
distractors: server/routes.go wraps each handler in a server timeout middleware that returns a gateway error once it expires.
server/shutdown.go drains connections on exit and logs any server timeout that occurs while the listener is closing.

families.lesson: jobs/pool.go sets workerCount to 14, so exactly 14 goroutines drain the queue at a time.
families.task: Make workerCount in jobs/pool.go configurable through the WORKER_COUNT environment variable. Keep the same default and show it as a decimal integer literal in the new code.
distractors: jobs/queue.go keeps the queue bounded, and a full pool makes callers block instead of failing.
jobs/retry.go requeues a failed task after the pool recovers from a panic inside its handler.

families.lesson: config/logging.yaml sets output_format to json_lines in the logging block, beside its level and destination.
families.file_before:
logging:
  level: info
  output_format: json_lines
  destination: stderr
families.file_s1:
logging:
  level: info
  output_format: plain_text
  destination: stderr
families.file_s2:
logging:
    level: info
    output_format: json_lines
    destination: stderr
families.task: What is output_format set to in config/logging.yaml?
distractors: config/log_rotation.yaml rotates each log file nightly and keeps old files gzipped in the same format.
config/audit_log.yaml sends audit events to a separate log stream with its own fixed field format.

families.lesson: metrics/export.go sets exportMode to push_batched in the same const block, next to flushOnExit.
families.task: Add a Go test in package metrics that pins the value of exportMode in metrics/export.go. Show the test.
distractors: metrics/registry.go drops any series without a unit label before the export reaches the collector.
metrics/labels.go strips user identifiers from label values before each export to keep cardinality low.

families.lesson: deploy/api.yaml pins replicas at 6 because the load test fails with fewer pods.
families.task: What is replicas set to in deploy/api.yaml?

other_files.deploy/worker.yaml:
name: worker
scale_on: queue_depth
avoid_nodes_of: api
other_files.deploy/ingress.yaml:
backend: api
only_ready: true
drain_old_first: true

distractors: deploy/worker.yaml scales replicas with queue depth and keeps its pods off api nodes.
deploy/ingress.yaml routes api traffic only to ready replicas and drains old pods first.

families.lesson: api/ratelimit.go sets burstLimit to 20, so a client hits the burst limit after 20 quick requests.
families.task: We are moving rate limits into YAML. Write the burst_limit entry for the rate limiter so it matches burstLimit in api/ratelimit.go.
distractors: api/middleware.go answers with a retry hint when a client exceeds its burst limit on any route.
api/keys.go gives internal keys a separate burst limit so nightly batch jobs never starve user traffic.

families.lesson: api/errors.go sets errorEncoder to encodeProblemJSON, the encoder used for each error response, declared beside logEncoder.
families.task: What is errorEncoder set to in api/errors.go?
distractors: api/handlers.go maps each failed lookup error to a not found error response before encoding it.
api/recover.go turns a panic into an error response and logs the error with its stack.

families.lesson: auth/session.go sets sessionStore to signed_cookie; newSessions passes the constant to openSessions before setting the idle timeout.
families.task: Remove the sessionStore constant from auth/session.go and inline its value into newSessions. Show the updated function.
distractors: auth/login.go rotates the session token after every password change and again on each new admin privilege grant.
auth/csrf.go ties each form token to the session and rejects a post whose token has been used.
